correctness.rationale: The scalar fixed-point equation u=tanh(beta*u/4) has one globally attracting root for beta<=4 and 3 hyperbolic roots for beta>4. Acyclic follower recursion determines unique followers for each leader root assignment; the full Jacobian is triangular with leader index signs and follower -1 diagonals. Variation-of-constants inductively forces every follower to its input limit, hence the exact complete basin sets, including saddle equality cylinders. For beta>4 compact cube plus local IFT at all finite hyperbolic equilibria excludes additional nearby equilibria. Sampled two-leader two-follower numeric nine-equilibria and index checks at beta=4.6,8 independently corroborated the finite examples.

final_claim: For a logistic continuous-time threshold network with s autonomous unit-feedback leaders and acyclic row-stochastic nonnegative followers, beta=4 is the sharp root threshold; above it 3^s equilibria, 2^s sinks, exact saddle-index counts binom(s,k)2^(s-k) and equipartitioned leader-cylinder basins of volume 2^-s; equilibrium counts and indices persist under sufficiently small row-stochastic feedback perturbations.
limitations: Only nonnegative row-stochastic acyclic follower rows and s fully autonomous self-feedback leaders.
At beta=4 unique equilibrium is nonhyperbolic; IFT persistence only beta>4.
For perturbed networks only equilibrium and index counts, not global convergence or basin cylinders, are proved.
residual_risks: Boudourides full text and appendices inaccessible; possible direct generalization/implicit special case under exactly same logistic model.
Exact cylinder basins cease to hold after adding follower feedback; only equilibrium counts and indices persist in that setting.
